headline: SEC Announces Fiscal Year 2027 Examination Priorities
summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission announced its Division of Examinations' Fiscal Year 2027 priorities report identifying key compliance and fraud prevention focus areas.
why: The SEC is the primary federal regulatory agency overseeing US securities markets, investment advisers, and broker-dealers.

impacts.name: Financial Services
impacts.why: Updated regulatory priorities signal compliance focus areas for registered financial institutions.
